description: Simple addition: O(1) time and space
code: function add(a: number, b: number): number { return a + b; }

description: Single for-of loop: O(n) time, O(1) space
code: function sumArray(arr: number[]): number { let s = 0; for (const x of arr) s += x; return s; }

description: Single while loop: O(n) time, O(1) space
code: function countdown(n: number): void { while (n > 0) n--; }

description: Two nested for loops: O(n²) time, O(1) space
code: function pairs(arr: number[]): void { for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { for (let j = 0; j < arr.length; j++) { void (arr[i]! + arr[j]!); } } }

description: Three nested for loops: O(n³) time, O(1) space — loop depth > 2 lowers confidence to medium
code: function cube(n: number): void { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { void (i + j + k); } } } }

description: Two sequential (not nested) for loops: dominant O(n)
code: function twoPass(arr: number[]): void { for (const x of arr) void x; for (const x of arr) void x; }

description: Array.sort() call: O(n log n) time, O(log n) space
code: function sortArr(arr: number[]): number[] { return arr.sort((a, b) => a - b); }

description: Array.map() creates new collection: O(n) time, O(n) space
code: function doubled(arr: number[]): number[] { return arr.map(x => x * 2); }

description: new Map allocation: O(1) time, O(n) space
code: function buildMap(keys: string[]): Map<string, number> { const m = new Map<string, number>(); for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) m.set(keys[i]!, i); return m; }

description: Set.has() lookup: O(1) time and space
code: function hasVal(s: Set<number>, v: number): boolean { return s.has(v); }

description: Array.includes() linear scan: O(n) time — engine reports O(n) space (time cost used as space proxy)
code: function contains(arr: number[], val: number): boolean { return arr.includes(val); }

description: Factorial: linear O(n) recursion, O(n) stack space
code: function factorial(n: number): number { if (n <= 1) return 1; return n * factorial(n - 1); }

description: mergeSort: divide-and-conquer O(n log n), O(log n) stack space
code: function mergeSort(arr: number[]): number[] { if (arr.length <= 1) return arr; const mid = Math.floor(arr.length / 2); const left = mergeSort(arr.slice(0, mid)); const right = mergeSort(arr.slice(mid)); return [...left, ...right]; }
function fib(n: number): number { if (n <= 1) return n; return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2); }

description: In-place loop with no allocation: O(n) time, O(1) space
code: function reverseInPlace(arr: number[]): void { let l = 0; let r = arr.length - 1; while (l < r) { const tmp = arr[l]!; arr[l] = arr[r]!; arr[r] = tmp; l++; r--; } }

description: Unknown method call produces uncertain node and low confidence
Map.has() O(1) vs Array.includes() O(n) — building a lookup set is O(n)
code: function buildLookup(items: string[]): Map<string, boolean> { const m = new Map<string, boolean>(); for (const item of items) m.set(item, true); return m; }

description: Array.reduce() single pass: O(n) time — engine reports O(n) space (time cost used as space proxy)
code: function total(arr: number[]): number { return arr.reduce((acc, x) => acc + x, 0); }
